book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: U KAꞌBꞌ Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU CORINTO Ikaꞌv uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Corinto uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: As itoxpa unqꞌelut veꞌt exeꞌ u vaaꞌ. As ech la ibꞌan kaꞌvoꞌj moj oxvoꞌj uxhchil tiꞌ bꞌen talat isuuchil umaj yol, echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: Tukꞌ iyol kaꞌvoꞌj uxhchil moj oxvoꞌj uxhchil uveꞌ la alon isuuchil tiꞌ ixochoneꞌ, as la nimali, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: As echat chit la ibꞌaneꞌ tul la oon in sexoꞌl, tan alel veꞌteꞌ sete svaꞌn uvaꞌ la oon in sexoꞌl unpajte. As kꞌuxh yeꞌl in at in sexoꞌl cheel, as la chit val veꞌt sete unpajte: Tul uvaꞌ la oon in sexoꞌl titoxpa, as techal la voksa vepaaveꞌ stuul tiꞌ unbꞌanat esuuchil, jankꞌal ex uveꞌ kat paavin ex naꞌytzan as tukꞌ unjoltu ex uvaꞌ yeꞌ neyaꞌsa epaavin cheel,
tan at ex ni alon uvaꞌ la unkꞌuch sete uvaꞌ aꞌ u Cristoeꞌ ni aqꞌon u vijleꞌmeꞌ tiꞌ valat unqꞌa yoleꞌ sete. As yeꞌle uvaꞌ yeꞌl koj iyakꞌil viyol Aakeꞌ uvaꞌ kat alpu sete. Pet at viyakꞌil Aakeꞌ sexoꞌl.

As kꞌuxh kat eesal iqꞌii u Cristoeꞌ, tul kat yatzꞌax Aak vatz u kuruseꞌ, as ech koj cheel, tan isleꞌl Aak taꞌn viyakꞌil u Tiixheꞌ. As echat in, tan kꞌuxh ni teesal unqꞌii echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ulbꞌel Aak, as tukꞌ viyakꞌil u Tiixheꞌ as isleꞌl in sexoꞌl tukꞌ u vijleꞌmeꞌ, echeꞌ u tijleꞌm u Cristo.

As ebꞌantaj teviꞌ ma nimamal u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Cristo setaꞌn, pet moj yeꞌle. As etitzꞌataj etibꞌ. ¿Moj yeꞌ ootzimal setaꞌn uveꞌ at veꞌt u Jesucristoeꞌ sekꞌatz? Asoj nimamal u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ setaꞌn, as aꞌeꞌ ni kꞌuchun uvaꞌ at Aak sekꞌatz. Pet asoj yeꞌ nesaꞌ enimataꞌ, as yeꞌl Aak at sekꞌatz.
As nunsaꞌ uvaꞌ la etootzi uvaꞌ at veꞌt u Jesucristo sukukꞌatz.

As nu kunach Tiixh setiꞌaj, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la etoksa etibꞌ tiꞌ enimat unqꞌa vaꞌlexheꞌ. As jit tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ilpu veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ at veꞌt u Cristoeꞌ sukukꞌatz uvaꞌ nu kunachkat Tiixh setiꞌ. Pet tiꞌ uvaꞌ la enima u bꞌaꞌneꞌ, kꞌuxh la alpu sqiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl u Cristo at sukukꞌatz.
As yeꞌ la uchi uvaꞌ la kumaj ex tiꞌ ebꞌanat u jikeꞌ. Pet aal la kuloch ex tiꞌ enimataꞌ.
As tul uvaꞌ nebꞌan u jikeꞌ, as nu kuchiibꞌeꞌ. As jit tzꞌajinal la kuyaa ex tukꞌ u qijleꞌmeꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ nu kunach Tiixh setiꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn etatineꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ.

As nuntzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u uꞌujeꞌ sete bꞌaxa tul uvaꞌ yeꞌxnaj bꞌen vilat ex unpajte, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la unkꞌaxbꞌisa ex tukꞌ u vijleꞌmeꞌ, tul la oon in sexoꞌl, tan kat taqꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesús u vijleꞌmeꞌ tiꞌ eyakꞌinsaleꞌ sevatzaj. As jit tiꞌ eyansaleꞌ.
Nitzojpisa u Pablo itzꞌibꞌat bꞌen u uꞌujeꞌ tu u Corinto

Tuk untzojpisa veꞌt unyolon sete, vitzꞌin vatzik. Yeꞌ txumun ex. Pet echuktaj txumbꞌal tiꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn etatineꞌ sevatzaj tiꞌ enimat unqꞌa yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni val sete. As unvatzuloj vetxumbꞌaleꞌ sevatzaj. As la atin u Tiixheꞌ sexoꞌl uveꞌ ni xoꞌnin oꞌ, tan Aakeꞌ ni aqꞌon sqe uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn qatin sukuvatzaj.
As ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl la etiixhi etibꞌ tan ex veꞌt niman tetz u Tiixheꞌ.
Ni taqꞌ bꞌen unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ itzii sete uvaꞌ at sunkꞌatz.

Aꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo la atin setiꞌaj. As aꞌ u Tiixheꞌ la txumun evatz, tan xoꞌn chit ex te Aak. As aꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritueꞌ la lochon ex, aqꞌal uvaꞌ unvatzul kuxh vetxumbꞌaleꞌ la ibꞌan sevatzaj. An chiteꞌ.

footnotes.text: 13.12 Aꞌ isuuchil u yoleꞌ tu yolbꞌal griego: Tul la etiixhi etibꞌ, as la itzꞌubꞌ tibꞌ txala etziꞌ sevatzaj.
